name.ja: Figure-rise Standard Amplified オメガモン(X抗体)

description.ja: 『DIGITAL MONSTER X-evolution』より、X抗体版の「オメガモン」がFigure-rise Standard Amplifiedシリーズにラインアップ！
description.en: From "DIGITAL MONSTER X-evolution ", the X-antibody version of " Omegamon" is now available in the Figure-rise Standard Amplified series!

description.ja: ■「X抗体デジモン」デザイナー「As’まりあ氏」監修。全高約200mm。
description.en: • Supervised by "X Antibody Digimon" designer As'Maria. Overall height approximately 200mm.

description.ja: ■プラモデルとしての拡張性を考慮し、各所に拡張用の接続穴を設定。
description.en: • Considering expandability as a plastic model, connection holes for expansion are set in various places.

description.ja: ■マントの付け根の取り付け位置を変える事で大きく展開することが可能。
description.en: • It is possible to expand the cloak by changing the attachment position at the base of the cloak.

description.ja: ■既存のAmplifified商品との組み合わせを徹底追求。さまざまな組み合わせ遊びが可能に。
description.en: • Thoroughly pursue combinations with existing Amplified products. Various combinations of play are possible.
